_note: G7 TURRET7B (G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-30): turret / mount traverse. ALL NUMBERS PROVISIONAL. Rates in deg/s (light RWS fast, heavy guns slow); a mount fires only once laid within tol_deg (tol_indirect_deg for indirect fire) of its target; after its last lay a mount holds hold_s (at least the weapon cooldown + 0.5 s), then returns to its rest bearing at the same rate (buildings: toward the map centre, wall turrets: the mount normal, vehicles: hull forward) and direct-fire building mounts scan +-scan_deg around it over scan_period_s. Modes: units.turret = separate turret / mount (the hull never swings to fire; turret drawn from the simulated bearing), units.hull = turreted vehicle / ship whose art has no separate turret (the whole sprite traverses at the gun rate instead of snapping; on the move unchanged). Buildings: every armed building (Combat weapon) is a mount; buildings overrides by def id, else the rate is derived from its weapon (derive_*). A unit def not listed keeps the old instant turn (infantry, turretless vehicles, aircraft). Everything lives under "_traverse7" (Content skips "_" keys: this file is not a content table fragment). rot_aim: G6 turrets whose art has only the 4 placement rotations rot_<f> (no head frames): the display turns the whole emplacement sprite to the nearest quarter of the simulated bearing (coarse, PROVISIONAL until head art exists); bunkers / pits / gates are not listed (their gun traverses in the sim only).
